name: com.xengine.zonezero
description: Zenless-Zone-Zero-style anime combat demo: YSA Toon shader re-implementation (smoothstep band lighting, position-based face normals, inverted-hull outline), 3-character tag team with 4-hit combo / dodge / big-skill camera cuts, and skill VFX. Depends on the shared Unity importer, InputSystem, Cinemachine and ProBuilder packages. Sample character assets are converted from a private reference project for internal testing only and must not be redistributed.

samples.description: Anbi/Corin/Nostradamus toon characters (tag-team switch, 4-hit combo with animation-event hit windows, front/back dodge, big-skill camera cuts) against Claymore training dummies in a ProBuilder arena, with weapon trails and hit sparks.
